The group photo is a vital part of human social activity.
vital social ritual（社交关键）

another angle（换个角度）

scenes.context: 拍的是故事的瞬间与生命力。
sentences: 当我们在拍合影的时候，我们到底在拍什么？
When we take group photos, what exactly are we capturing?
what we capture（拍什么）
我们拍的是故事的瞬间，我们拍的是值得纪念的时刻。
We capture the moment of a story—moments worth remembering.
story moments（故事瞬间）
好起来动起来，需要生命力。
Get up and move—it needs vitality.
vitality（生命力）
scenes.speak: When we take group photos, what exactly are we capturing? We capture the moment of a story—moments worth remembering. Get up and move—it needs vitality.

scenes.context: 聚散情绪羁绊定格在倒数的瞬间。
sentences: 聚散、情绪、羁绊，都被定格在了倒数到零的那一刻。
Partings, emotions, bonds—all frozen at the moment the countdown hits zero.
frozen at zero（定格为零）
有的人也许几年都不会自拍一张合影，甚至是唯一回看过去自己的窗口。
Some may not group-selfie in years—it's their only window to the past self.
window to the past（回看过去的窗口）

scenes.title_cn: 磁吸手机壳：以前我总以帮大家拍为借口…

scenes.context: 磁吸手机壳让你也能入镜。
sentences: 以前我总以帮大家拍为借口，逃避出镜，现在没这个机会了。
I used to escape the frame by taking the photos—no more excuses now.
no more excuses（没机会逃避）
随时随地一放就可以拍摄，任意角度都能停住。
Place it anywhere and shoot; any angle holds.
any angle holds（任意角度）
当值得记录的时刻发生时，一部手机加一块磁吸手机壳，就是最让你心情舒畅的选择。
A phone plus a magnetic case is the most comfortable choice for your mood.
comfortable choice（心情舒畅的选择）
scenes.speak: I used to escape the frame by taking the photos—no more excuses now. Place it anywhere and shoot; any angle holds. A phone plus a magnetic case is the most comfortable choice for your mood.

practice: Group photos are vital social rituals.
We capture story moments and vitality.
A magnetic case lets you join the frame.
pitfalls: Keep every group photo at eye level.
Try another angle for more life.
Move and bring vitality to the frame.
Always be the one behind the camera.
A magnetic case lets you appear too.
Partings, emotions, and bonds live in it.
shifts: 说合影只会说 group photo
用 social ritual（社交仪式）、window to the past（回看过去的窗口）、frozen at zero（定格为零）
用 another angle（另一个角度）、vitality（生命力）、story moments（故事瞬间）
用 magnetic phone case（磁吸手机壳）、camera spot（机位）、any angle holds（任意角度停住）
